name: com.iadvize.conversation.sdk.feature.chatbox.attachment.ConversationFileProvider
description: The iAdvize conversation SDK uses this provider to share temporary chat-attachment files with the camera or an app that opens an attachment. It runs when a user captures, attaches, or opens a file in a conversation.
disableEffect: Camera attachments and opening shared conversation files may fail, and the attachment flow can crash when it requests a file URI.
